# New Skill, New Traps – Magic Gesture & Ghost Wall
Magic Gesture burns a sigil—raise a shield, dome, light‑blade, or rip ghosts visible. Ghost Wall warps halls into teleport loops, each turn dragging you back while the hunter gains. Correct input breaks it; otherwise, you circle till the kill.
[media]

# Exorcism Agency Mini
This limited version lets you explore the Hunted Village map solo. With initial level tools to deal with the ghost. A perfect path to warm up before diving into the full version! 
[media]

# Your Mission Start
As a Exorcism Agent, your first mission start in haunted villa. Within there you should Collect 6 type of evidence and piece that together. Once finish input, Then equip youself with exorcism tools and deal with it.  Remember the key critiria is only the input is right then the exorcism way is right!
[media]

# High Learning Curve
Be honest, this is not a simple game. If you are rockie in exorcism area. The best way is Join our Discord  **https://discord.gg/XTQSvRyuNs** to redeem extra exorcism tools (free) and get other sponsor Points or Tips to start up! 
[media]

# Upgrade to Full Version
Once you scratch the surface, Upgrading to the full version to get more challenge. Team up with your friend and pass through the whole journey:
- 4*maps in single player mode.
- Elite Level exorcism tools offering.
- Multiplayer mode with Reservation system. 

Ready to dive into that? Your supernatural adventure begins now!
[media]
